risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a full rebuild or internal overhaul

proof_requests: Video of the transmission shifting through all gears under power
Close-up photo of any part number, model plate, or VIN sticker on the casing
Photo showing whether the torque converter is included
Import documents or service history supporting Belgium origin and low mileage
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used automatic transmission, so a worst-case price is possible; every seller claim about brand, origin, function, mileage and fitment is unproven and is priced at the lowest viable condition.
